description: Security fixes: GC auth fail-closed, middleware GC route auth, Prisma proxy binding, dead auth code removal, requireServiceToken fail-closed
steps: Fix src/app/api/gc/commands/route.ts: Change `if (!token) return true` to `if (!token) return process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'` so it only fails open in development

Fix src/lib/db.ts: In the Proxy getter, bind functions to db.client: `const value = db.client[prop as keyof PrismaClient]; if (typeof value === 'function') { return (value as Function).bind(db.client); } return value;`

Fix src/middleware.ts: Expand isServiceRoute or add new logic for /api/gc/* routes. For GC routes, require GC_AUTH_TOKEN as bearer token for all methods (GET, POST, PATCH). In production (non-demo, non-development), reject without valid token with 401. Allow existing handler-level auth to remain (belt and suspenders). Add this BEFORE the demo mode check (step 3 in middleware) since GC routes should require auth even outside demo mode.

Fix src/lib/auth.ts: Delete the requireAuth function entirely. Change requireServiceToken to fail closed: when SERVICE_TOKEN env var is not set, return a 401 response (matching middleware pattern) instead of null.

Update src/lib/__tests__/auth.test.ts: Remove all requireAuth tests. Add/update requireServiceToken tests: test that when SERVICE_TOKEN is not set it returns 401 (not null), test valid token returns null, test invalid token returns 401, test missing header returns 401.
Add GC_AUTH_TOKEN to .env.example with a comment explaining it's required for production GC command API auth.
acceptance_criteria: GC authenticate function returns false (not true) when no token is configured in production
Prisma proxy binds functions to the real client so $transaction works correctly
Middleware rejects unauthenticated requests to /api/gc/* in production with 401
requireAuth function no longer exists in src/lib/auth.ts
requireServiceToken returns 401 when SERVICE_TOKEN is not configured (fail closed)
findings: All changes verified. Build, test (336 tests), and lint pass. The lint rule @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-function-type required using `(...args: unknown[]) => unknown` instead of `Function` for the Prisma proxy bind cast. requireAuth was only used in groundcrew/ (separate project with its own auth.ts) so removing from src/lib/auth.ts is safe.
